read.description: true when you read every file of submission/ (and original/ when present) and, in full, every earlier submission you compared closely or whose idea has no summary in earlier/INDEX.md (another way after a tool failed counts); false only if one of those stayed unread

copies.description: the earlier/ directory it copies, if it fails

fixable.description: when a check fails: true only if deleting parts of the submission (files, words, punctuation), keeping its idea, would make every check pass; false otherwise (e.g. no idea of its own, a copy). When all pass: true

idea.description: the submission's idea in two to four plain, neutral sentences: the failure it targets, how the edit is found, what it changes (later reviewers compare other submissions with it)
